camera.note: shift <= 3 px over the clip, far below the object's ~540-870 px/frame motion; no correction needed
camera.view: low camera at floor level, looking horizontally at a wall; floor recedes upward to the wall at y~960

cup.description: the only moving object: a small cup/pot-shaped object, black rounded top and white lower body (looks like a white cup holding a black ball / black-topped toy), dragged left-to-right across the wooden floor by a dark cord attached at its right side
cup.reference_point: top_halfmax_cx (horizontal centre of the black top, blur-robust) for x; cy = bbox centre for y
cup.x_centre_note: frames 1, 2, 7 are clipped by the image edge, so their centres are biased (towards the inside of the image); use frames 3-6 for clean motion

length_px_along_motion.method: half-max width of the black top's darkness profile, frames 3-6 (motion-blur robust); blurred mask bbox width is 596-686

height_px.method: mask bbox height (top of black dome to bottom of white body), frames 3-6; grows slowly as the object moves slightly down-image / toward camera

cup.motion_direction: left to right (+x), slight downward drift in image (cy 1278 -> 1340 over frames 3-6)

cord.description: dark thin cable/string attached to the right side of the cup, pulled toward the right; lies on the floor in frame 0 from the left edge (y~1130-1200) and later stretches up to the right edge
cord.note: not tracked (thin, motion-blurred); it is the pulling agent

floor.description: light-brown wood floor/table, the plane of motion

rail.description: long white/grey tube (whiteboard tray or baseboard rail) along the wall base spanning the full image width

bracket_left.description: black bracket/clip on the rail, left

bracket_right.description: black bracket/clip on the rail, right

events.event: cord already moving/lying on floor, cup not yet in view
